title: A process list
description:
Show a list of processes and change their states.

```
PID  STATE     NAME
1    running   init
42   ready     editor
43   waiting   downloader
> block 42
42 is now waiting
```
hints: `run <pid>` first moves the running process back to `ready` (lesson 6.02).
`wake` only works on a waiting process and makes it `ready`, not `running`.
requirements: States are `ready`, `running` and `waiting`; only one process can be `running`.
Commands `run`, `block`, `wake` and `list` change and show them.
stretch: Add priorities and make `run` with no number pick the ready process with the highest one.
